title: Italy lose 0–2 to Belgium with two Inter men starting
description: Lega Serie A has confirmed Inter's dates and kickoff times through matchday 19, and the Coppa Italia last 16 against Genoa is on the calendar too.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 25, Saturday, September 26, 2026 — Italy lose 0–2 to Belgium with two Inter men starting

blocks.html: Italy lost 0–2 to Belgium at the Stadio Olimpico on Friday night, with two Inter men in the starting eleven. Inter’s calendar is now set a long way out: Serie A has confirmed times through matchday 19, and the Coppa Italia last 16 falls on Tuesday, December 1. Inter Women open their league season on Sunday, and entry is free.

blocks.h3: Italy lose 0–2 to Belgium with two Nerazzurri starting
paras: Belgium won at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome on Friday night. Mika Godts scored in the 21st minute and Dodi Lukebakio made it two in the 69th.
Nicolò Barella, the Inter midfielder, played 80 minutes. Francesco Pio Esposito, the Inter forward, came off after 65.

Piotr Zieliński, the Inter midfielder, played all 90 minutes for Poland in a 0–0 draw with Bosnia and Herzegovina in Warsaw. Andy Diouf, the Inter midfielder, was an unused substitute in France's 1–0 win in Turkey.

blocks.h3: Serie A fixes Inter's dates through matchday 19
paras: Lega Serie A has confirmed dates and kickoff times from matchday 13 to matchday 19. Inter host Genoa on Saturday, November 28 at 2:45 PM ET, which is 20:45 CET. The run ends at home to Juventus on Sunday, January 10, also at 2:45 PM ET.
The club has a Coppa Italia date too. Inter, the holders, meet Genoa in the last 16 at San Siro on Tuesday, December 1 at 3:00 PM ET, which is 21:00 CET.

blocks.h3: Inter Women open Serie A at the Arena Civica on Sunday
paras: Inter Women play Fiorentina on Sunday at 7:00 AM ET, which is 13:00 CEST, at the Arena Civica Gianni Brera in Milan. It is matchday 1 of Serie A Women, and entry is free.
Inter go into it off a winning debut in the Women's Champions League against Häcken. David Sassarini is the Inter Women head coach; Fiorentina are coached by Pablo Piñones Arce.

blocks.h3: Corriere dello Sport: Inter scouting a River Plate goalkeeper
paras: Corriere dello Sport says Inter's scouts have watched Santiago Beltrán, the 21-year-old River Plate goalkeeper, as an option for the future. The paper credits ESPN with the report and says Manchester United and Real Madrid are also tracking him.
River Plate are negotiating a renewal that would lift his release clause from €25 million to €100 million. Josep Martínez is Inter's pick in goal this season.
blocks.kicker: CORRIERE DELLO SPORT VIA FCINTERNEWS · SEP 26

blocks.h3: Gazzetta dello Sport: Bastoni returns for Italy in Bursa
paras: Italy play Turkey on Monday at 2:45 PM ET, which is 20:45 CEST, at the Atatürk Spor Kompleksi in Bursa. Gazzetta dello Sport, Italy's biggest sports daily, expects several changes from Roberto Mancini, the Italy head coach.
Alessandro Bastoni, the Inter defender, is certain to start after missing the Belgium match while suspended.
